title: Don Paul thanks Greer for those stuck in legacy programs

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for UFO disclosure, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that a man named Don Paul once picked him up in Los Angeles and dropped him off where he was staying. Greer says Paul thanked him on behalf of people stuck inside so-called legacy programs, secret projects said to hold recovered non-human technology, which would mean insiders support his push to make it public.
